items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And I had made a trip down to visit my friend, Jack Robbins.

ctx.x: Ella Fitzgerald had developed -- she was singing much better after the road trip. She came back, she was singing much better.
And I had made a trip down to visit my friend, Jack Robbins. And he had talked to me about a deal where he would support us in the arrangement.
See, he's a -- got -- hired Greggman to come in to help him with the big three companies. A lot of pictures were coming out of Hollywood and had all these hit songs.
